posts.description: I took a one hour nap and for that sin I was condemned to do nothing more than resting with my eyes closed for about half the night and being completely awake for the rest. Heading to the gym because why the fuck not at this point. I knew it was a bad idea to take that nap but last time I felt tired and forced myself to stay awake a few more hours, I also didn't sleep, so.... ALRIGHT THEN.
